how_to_find: Open your own fork of the super-connector-mcp repo on GitHub. Read the date and short sha of the newest commit. Compare it to the commit sha on each version below.

versions.title: Content idea tools and README
versions.summary: Adds three content asset tools and a README with deployment notes and a tool list (29 tools in total). Commit 1193bda (content tools) and commit e5dcd49 (README), both dated 2026-04-16. VERIFY: no git tag exists that this wizard can see. The id comes from the commit date. This is the newest commit seen at wizard release on 2026-10-22.

changes.text: README with deployment notes, tool list and known gaps.

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: On your fork page on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself. Start a new Claude chat to load the new tools.

versions.title: First release with delete tools
versions.summary: First release of the server: contacts, initiatives, sub-projects, stakeholders, action items, buckets, follow-ups, events, brain dump and health check. Delete tools for initiatives, contacts and sub-projects were added the same day. Commits 31c322f and d527eda, dated 2026-04-01. VERIFY: dates and content come from commit messages only.

changes.text: Initial MCP server on streamable HTTP.
Host and port now set in the FastMCP constructor, not in run().
